CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Neoraid** is a modern theme for the Unraid 7.3 webGUI that keeps the Unraid palette: light and dark mode with a switch in the navigation bar, a redesigned Dashboard and accent colour, density, corner and font options in *Settings → Neoraid*. It adds a stylesheet layer on top of the stock theme and changes no system file; removing the plugin restores the stock look.
For bugs and questions open an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/veaceslavmafteiaevoluta/neoraid/issues
